claims.sourceText: Transcript of Phil Schneider's May 1995 Post Falls, Idaho lecture, https://www.difoet.dk/www.raven1.net/mcf/underground-bases.htm , and Norio Hayakawa, 29 August 2016, both opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: THE SPECIFICATION, AND WHERE IT COMES FROM. Every specific number in the modern claim comes from one lecture, at Post Falls, Idaho on 8 May 1995, in which Phil Schneider said the base 'goes down seven levels and over 2.5 miles deep' and described a firefight in which he shot two aliens and about seventy people were killed. He was not part of the initial rumours and arrived fifteen years after they began.

claims.text: In the same lecture he gave the specification that the whole modern claim rests on: 'It goes down seven levels and over 2.5 miles deep.'

claims.sourceText: Transcript of Phil Schneider's May 1995 Post Falls, Idaho lecture, https://www.difoet.dk/www.raven1.net/mcf/underground-bases.htm , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: In the Post Falls, Idaho lecture of 8 May 1995 Schneider said he was 'involved in building an addition to the deep underground military base at Dulce' and that his job was 'to go down the holes and check the rock samples, and recommend the explosive[s]'. Tier 2 as a record of what he said: the transcript is hosted without a named transcriber and the lecture recording itself carries no captions.

claims.sourceText: Transcript of Phil Schneider's May 1995 Post Falls, Idaho lecture, https://www.difoet.dk/www.raven1.net/mcf/underground-bases.htm , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: In the same lecture he described the alleged 1979 firefight: 'We found ourselves amidst a large cavern that was full of outer-space aliens...I shot two of them. At that time, there were 30 people down there. About 40 more came down after this started, and all of them got killed.' The hosting page's own introduction gives a different figure, sixty-six dead. The internal inconsistency is part of the record.
